path.description: An absolute path to a Beancount or hledger journal; its own include directives are followed by Farolfi.

text.description: Inline journal text; it has no directory to resolve include directives against.

format.description: Overrides format auto-detection for inline text.

begin.description: Inclusive ISO date lower bound for dated reports.

end.description: Exclusive ISO date upper bound for dated reports.

depth.description: Account-tree depth to roll balances up to.

requireMeta.description: For report "check" only: a transaction metadata key every transaction must carry.
